intro: Matilda Riverside is an HDB project in Punggol. A third-party completion estimate is on file, but this entry is not officially confirmed: HDB has not verified a project-wide key date, and tracker sources have disagreed on the month. Unit counts and any estimated month are therefore left out of the facts below. The word “Riverside” is not treated as a confirmed outlook; we will not assign a water or park view to your block. If you have an HDB key-appointment letter, use that. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Matilda Riverside renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Matilda Riverside interior
sections.text:
Punggol is a newer, still-growing north-eastern town, and owners who are close to keys usually want the first fit-out to work as a long stay in that landscape: storage for family life, a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, and a living-room joinery wall rather than a temporary arrangement of loose cabinets. Maison designs that work as built-in carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we can present it in a wide room view or in closer studies of a kitchen run, a wardrobe or a headboard wall. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies and room sizes are not listed, and we will not invent a typical Matilda Riverside layout.

We will not invent walking times to Punggol town, to any waterway, or to any MRT station. Check your own block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds, a window bench or any hacking. Nearby links on this site are limited in Punggol itself in this batch; readers in the wider north-east can also see Fernvale Sails in Sengkang, packed in this batch, and Tanjong Tree Residences @ Hougang. Those pages are not typologies or key-date references for Matilda Riverside.

After keys, inspect defects, measure, and obtain the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
